The '''signal monitoring center''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] structure located in the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] took over the monitoring center as one of their forward bases deep in the Tomb, though it was manned only by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The signal monitoring center appears as an Imperial base on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
